description: Work on a project's existing problems (bugs, blockers). list: open problems. tree: one problem with every attempt and its solution. add_attempt: record a try. end_attempt: how a try ended. solve: close it with what fixed it (manage_history undo reopens it). Call add_attempt or solve right after a fix, and again before you end or hand back. Open a new problem with log_work kind=problem. Reads: list, tree. Writes need project. Returns problem rows, the tree, or the saved attempt or solution.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

attempt_id.description: end_attempt: the attempt's id (from add_attempt or tree).

code_snippet.description: solve: the fix as text. No secrets.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

parent_attempt_id.description: add_attempt: an earlier attempt this one builds on.

problem_id.description: tree / add_attempt / solve: the problem's id.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for writes; list: omit for all projects.

name: manage_problems
